noticias.texto: Aaron Judge is not on the Yankees' roster for the AL Wild Card series against the Red Sox, a source confirmed to ESPN.

noticias.titular: Cubs' Matthew Boyd to start Game 1 against Padres
noticias.texto: The Cubs will start LHP Matthew Boyd in Game 1 opposite Padres righty Michael King. Alex Bregman's availability on defense, meanwhile, remains up in the air.

noticias.titular: Yankees and Red Sox, who produce some of baseball's most memorable melodrama, meet in playoffs again
noticias.texto: — Yankees-Red Sox matchups have produced plenty of melodrama, with video clips of Bucky Dent, Pedro Martínez, Aaron Boone, Curt Schilling and Dave Roberts becoming a staple of videoboards and TV broadcasts.

noticias.titular: Padres and Cubs meet to start the NL Wild Card Series
noticias.texto: Chicago Cubs (89-73, second in the NL Central during the regular season) vs. San Diego Padres (91-71, second in the NL West during the regular season)

noticias.titular: A pair of unlikely playoff teams collide as the Astros face the White Sox in AL Wild Card Series
noticias.texto: — The Houston Astros are the first team to reach the postseason without a winning record.

noticias.titular: Braves put trust in Sale to anchor depleted rotation in NL Wild Card Series against Phillies
noticias.texto: — The Atlanta Braves battled through a long list of pitching injuries that left their rotation depleted for their National League Wild Card Series against the Philadelphia Phillies.

noticias.titular: Astros owner: Playoff berth will factor into call on Espada
noticias.texto: Astros owner Jim Crane said Monday the team's playoff berth will be "something to consider" when deciding on the future of manager Joe Espada, whose contract expires after the season.

noticias.titular: Luis Arraez (ankle) won't be on Phillies' wild card roster
noticias.texto: Luis Arraez won't be on the Phillies' wild-card roster as he continues to recover from a sprained ankle he suffered late in the regular season.

noticias.titular: Aaron Judge takes BP as Yankees' roster call nears
noticias.texto: Aaron Judge participated in batting practice on the field Monday for the first time since suffering a right calf strain Sept. 16, as he works to persuade the team's decision-makers to put him on their wild-card series roster against the Boston Red Sox.

noticias.titular: MLB announces umpire crew chiefs for Wild Card Series
noticias.texto: Jordan Baker, Bill Miller, Alan Porter and Mark Wegner will be the umpire crew chiefs for this week's Wild Card Series.

noticias.titular: Red Sox rookie LHP Payton Tolle to start Game 1 vs. Yankees
noticias.texto: Red Sox rookie left-hander Payton Tolle will start Tuesday night's AL Wild Card Series opener against the Yankees and will be followed in the rotation by Sonny Gray and Ranger Suarez.

noticias.titular: Misiorowski tops in ERA, K's; Alvarez, Moreno win batting titles
noticias.texto: Houston's Yordan Alvarez and Arizona's Gabriel Moreno won their first batting titles, while Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski became just the fourth pitcher since 1950 to lead the majors in ERA, strikeouts and opponents' batting average.

noticias.titular: MLB playoffs 2026: Ranking teams by World Series pressure
noticias.texto: For some teams this October, a victory would be even sweeter -- and a defeat all the more painful.

noticias.titular: White Sox's Montgomery looks to 'positives,' not strikeout record
noticias.texto: Colson Montgomery wants to focus on the "positives" from his second year in the majors, not the single season strikeout record he broke on Friday.

noticias.titular: Astros win their 5th AL West title in the last 6 years, despite 81-81 record
noticias.texto: The Astros won their fifth AL West title in six years despite finishing with the worst record for a first-place team, beating the Athletics 9-0 Sunday behind Lucas Spence's two-run triple to finish at 81-81.
